title: Observation drawing sheet
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Skeletons, muscles, nutrition and plants (Tribal Tales)
source: Seeded from science/y3 lesson 3 (Observation drawing sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 3: How water moves through a plant. To understand how water travels from the roots up the stem to the leaves

questions.a: For example: The leaves will turn blue because the water goes up the stem.
questions.model: Start with what you think: 'The leaves will turn blue.' Then why: 'because the water travels up the stem.'

questions.q: Why do we use coloured water?
questions.a: So we can see where the water goes

questions.q: What do the tubes in a stem do?
Set up your celery or white flower in coloured water with an adult. Draw it on day 1 and write your prediction.
questions.a: Labelled drawing and a prediction with 'because'
questions.model: Teacher sets up a celery stick in blue water on camera and draws it: 'Day 1: green leaves, clear stem.'

questions.q: Look at the photo of celery after one day cut across. What are the coloured dots?
questions.a: The ends of the tubes that carry water

questions.q: Why might a plant on a hot, sunny day need more water?
questions.a: More water evaporates from its leaves, so more must come up from the roots.

questions.q: Water moves up a plant through the...
Big question: how does water reach the top of a tall tree?
questions.a: It travels up through tiny tubes in the trunk from the roots to the leaves.
